title: Critter Lab
game_overview: Master bilingual science vocabulary through flashcards, matching, blanks, and word puzzles to nurture and evolve a cute pixel pocket companion.
winning_condition: Complete study rounds with accuracy to earn Care Treats and XP, evolving your pocket companion to Stage 4 and mastering all Level 1-3 science vocabulary.
losing_condition: Losing all 3 hearts in a scored quiz mode ends the current study round early; letting companion Hunger, Happiness, and Energy all hit zero makes the companion sulk until fed and cared for.

controls.action: Pet the companion, pick multiple-choice flashcard answers, match translation pairs, select fill-in-the-blank options, and tap puzzle letter tiles.
Press 1-4 in Flashcard MC mode, type letters in Word Puzzle or Fill-in-the-Blanks modes, and confirm or advance with Enter/Space.

controls.input: Arrow Keys / A-D / Virtual Touch Buttons
controls.action: Nudge the pocket companion across the sanctuary desk or navigate study cards.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Flashcards (MC): Multiple-choice bilingual quiz showing an English science term and 4 Traditional Chinese options (selectable by click/tap or keys 1-4) with instant color+icon feedback and XP rewards. 2. Translation Matching: Connect shuffled English science terms with their Traditional Chinese translations on a grid; streaks multiply points and drop bonus snacks. 3. Fill in the Blanks: Complete science statements by selecting or typing the missing English term; hints (Traditional Chinese meaning and clue) are hidden by default with a player-controlled Show/Hide Hint toggle per question. 4. Word Puzzle: Unscramble or spell English vocabulary letter-by-letter using clickable pixel letter tiles or keyboard input, with a Hint button that reveals one letter. 5. XP Care Shop, Active Stat Decay & Species-Aligned Growth: Hunger, Happiness, and Energy steadily consume over time and across study rounds, encouraging regular study. When stats drop low, the companion stops wandering and displays a sad, low-energy slumped expression until fed, cleaned, or played with using earned Spendable XP.
sections.summary: Four study mini-games (with MC flashcards and toggleable Fill-in-the-Blanks hints) paired with brisk stat decay, low-stat sad animations, and an XP Care Shop.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Companion crouches slightly before hopping; letter tiles pop upward on hover. State Change Juice: Dedicated special companion animations play on the desk for each care action—happy chomping with flying crumbs when fed a Star Biscuit, brisk bubble-scrubbing shimmy with gleaming sparkles when cleaned with Bubble Soap, and playful pouncing/chasing after a bouncing striped Bouncy Toy Ball when played with. When Hunger, Happiness, or Energy run low, the companion stops moving around, slumps with droopy sad eyes and a frown, and shows floating tired/hungry mood cues until cared for. Impact Juice: Completing a word or match triggers a confetti burst, subtle canvas bounce, combo chime pitch escalation, and a celebratory evolution flash.
sections.summary: Dedicated feed/clean/play companion animations, low-stat sad posture, particle bursts, and Web Audio chiptune cues.
